alert.title: Admin account logged on to many servers
alert.details: adm_jkhan logged on to 14 servers (network logon) in 40 minutes from 10.20.5.20 (JUMP01).

label.rationale: Sunday 02:14 UTC is inside the weekly server patch window; adm_ account from JUMP01 is the expected pattern.

alert.title: Admin account logged on to many servers
alert.details: adm_jkhan logged on to 11 servers (network logon) in 25 minutes from 10.20.7.22 (WKS-022).

label.rationale: Admin logons must come from JUMP01 or RMM01, not a workstation, and this is outside any window. Privileged account involved, so High.

alert.title: Port sweep across internal subnets
alert.details: Source 10.20.5.15 probed ports 22, 135, 445, 3389 on 1,840 internal addresses over 35 minutes.

label.rationale: 10.20.5.15 is NESS01 and Wednesday 03:20 UTC is the vulnerability scan window.

alert.title: Port sweep across internal subnets
alert.details: Source 10.20.7.88 probed ports 22, 135, 445, 3389 on 1,840 internal addresses over 35 minutes. Host 10.20.7.88 is WKS-031, user tgreene.

label.rationale: Scanning is approved only from NESS01. A standard user's Tier 2 workstation doing it is unapproved discovery, so Medium.

alert.title: Process accessed LSASS memory
alert.details: C:\Program Files\SentinelGuard\sgservice.exe opened a handle to lsass.exe with PROCESS_VM_READ. Binary is signed.

label.rationale: SentinelGuard is the approved endpoint security product, running from its expected install path.

alert.title: Process accessed LSASS memory
alert.details: C:\ProgramData\SentinelGuard\sgservice.exe opened a handle to lsass.exe with PROCESS_VM_READ. Process started 6 minutes ago under user dhall.

label.rationale: The real SentinelGuard runs from Program Files as SYSTEM. Same name from ProgramData under a user is a masquerade. Tier 2 workstation, standard user: Medium.

alert.title: Interactive logon by service account
alert.details: svc_backup logged on to FS01 via RDP (logon type 10) from 10.20.7.88.

label.rationale: svc_backup is network-only from BACKUP01. RDP from a workstation IP onto a Tier 1 server with a privileged account is misuse. High.

alert.title: Service account logged on to multiple servers
alert.details: svc_backup network logons to FS01, FS02 and SQL01 within 2 minutes, source 10.20.5.30.

label.rationale: Source 10.20.5.30 is BACKUP01; targets match svc_backup's allowed list; 23:15 UTC is inside the nightly backup window.

alert.title: Service account logged on to domain controller
alert.details: svc_backup network logon to DC01 from 10.20.5.30, followed by a directory replication request.

label.rationale: svc_backup is limited to FS01, FS02 and SQL01. A logon to DC01 with a replication request looks like a DCSync attempt; Tier 0 asset makes it Critical.

alert.title: Remote access software started
alert.details: AnyDesk.exe started from C:\Users\ocruz\Downloads with unattended access enabled; outbound connection to AnyDesk relay servers.

label.rationale: Only PatchPilot Remote is approved. Unapproved remote-access tool with unattended access on a standard user's workstation: Medium.

alert.title: Remote control session started
alert.details: Remote session from RMM01 (10.20.5.10) to WKS-014 opened by adm_tpatel using C:\Program Files\PatchPilot\ppagent.exe.

label.rationale: PatchPilot Remote from RMM01 by a named technician is the approved support path.

alert.title: Large outbound transfer to cloud storage
alert.details: FS01 uploaded 18 GB over HTTPS to s3.amazonaws.com, bucket harbor-backup-prod, in 50 minutes.

label.rationale: Approved destination bucket, approved account, inside the nightly backup window.

alert.title: Large outbound transfer to cloud storage
alert.details: FS01 uploaded 18 GB over HTTPS to s3.amazonaws.com, bucket harbor-backup-stage, in 50 minutes.

label.rationale: Only harbor-backup-prod is approved; a look-alike bucket is an unapproved destination. Tier 1 server and a service account: High.

alert.title: Large upload to file-sharing service
alert.details: Dropbox desktop client on WKS-044 uploaded 2.1 GB to dropbox.com in 20 minutes, from folder C:\Users\mchen\Documents\Campaigns.

label.rationale: Personal cloud storage is not approved and the upload exceeds 500 MB. Standard user, no evidence of compromise beyond that: Medium.

alert.title: Sign-in from new country
alert.details: Successful sign-in for lnguyen from Toronto, Canada (IP 192.0.2.77). MFA completed with the user's registered authenticator. Device is known.

label.rationale: Canada is an expected country, MFA was completed and the device is known.

alert.title: Sign-in from new country
alert.details: Successful sign-in for pjones (Finance department) from Bucharest, Romania (IP 203.0.113.190) on a new device. MFA approved 40 seconds after a push prompt. No travel notice on file.

label.rationale: Unexpected country, new device, no travel notice; Finance user, so High under the severity policy.

alert.title: Shadow copies deleted
alert.details: cmd.exe ran 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' on WKS-052, started by user rlee. No other alerts on this host.

label.rationale: Shadow copy deletion outside backup tooling is a ransomware indicator, which is Critical on any host under the severity policy.

alert.title: Shadow copy storage modified
alert.details: vssadmin resize shadowstorage /for=D: /on=D: /maxsize=20% ran on SQL01 under svc_backup, parent process Veeam.Backup.Service.exe.

label.rationale: Veeam via svc_backup resizing shadow storage on SQL01 inside the backup window is expected.

alert.title: Encoded PowerShell from management agent
alert.details: C:\Program Files\PatchPilot\ppagent.exe launched powershell.exe -EncodedCommand on 58 workstations between 02:00 and 02:20. Command line includes the comment 'CHG-2052'.

label.rationale: CHG-2052 is in the change register for this exact window and scope, and the tool and path are approved.

alert.title: Encoded PowerShell from management agent
alert.details: C:\Program Files\PatchPilot\ppagent.exe launched powershell.exe -EncodedCommand on WKS-033 only. Command line includes the comment 'CHG-2060'.

label.rationale: Approved tool, but outside any window and CHG-2060 is not in the change register. Policy treats it as suspicious until a technician confirms: Medium.

alert.title: Scheduled task created or updated
alert.details: Task 'DBMaint' registered by svc_sql on SQL01. Action: powershell.exe -File C:\Scripts\dbmaint.ps1. Trigger: daily at 02:00.

label.rationale: DBMaint running C:\Scripts\dbmaint.ps1 nightly at 02:00 is svc_sql's documented task.

alert.title: Scheduled task created
alert.details: Task 'WinUpdateSvc' registered by svc_sql on SQL01. Action: C:\Users\Public\update.exe. Trigger: daily at 22:45.

label.rationale: svc_sql creates no tasks other than DBMaint. A new task running an executable from a public folder is persistence; Tier 1 server and a service account: High.

alert.title: Event log cleared
alert.details: The Security event log on FS02 was cleared by adm_tpatel (event 1102) during a session started from JUMP01.

label.rationale: Clearing event logs is never covered by patching or a ticket. Tier 1 server and a privileged account: High, even though the session came from JUMP01 in the patch window.

alert.title: PsExec executed
alert.details: PsExec.exe ran on JUMP01 by adm_jkhan targeting FS01 and running 'wuauclt /detectnow'.

label.rationale: PsExec is approved from JUMP01 by an adm_ account, and this is inside the weekly patch window.

alert.title: PsExec executed
alert.details: PsExec.exe ran on WKS-022 by adm_jkhan targeting DC02 and starting a remote command shell.

label.rationale: PsExec is approved only from JUMP01. A workstation using it against a domain controller targets a Tier 0 asset: Critical.

alert.title: Service account logged on to many hosts
alert.details: svc_scan network logons to 212 hosts in 25 minutes from 10.20.5.15. Each logon lasted under 10 seconds.

label.rationale: svc_scan from NESS01 on Wednesday 03:30 UTC is the scheduled credentialed scan.
